name: orbit-hq
description: Your home for Claude Code: every chat, usage & cost, and your whole setup in one calm sidebar. 100% local.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Orbit HQ
walkthroughs.description: Every chat, your usage and your whole Claude Code setup, in one sidebar. Five minutes to learn, then it just works.

steps.title: Open Orbit
steps.description:
Orbit lives in the bar on the far left: look for the planet. You can also press Ctrl+Alt+O (Cmd+Alt+O on Mac) at any time.
[Open Orbit](command:orbit.open)

media.altText: Orbit Home: what is running, where you left off, and today's usage

steps.title: Pick up any chat
steps.description:
Every Claude Code chat, from the terminal and the extension, newest first. Click one to continue right where Claude stopped. Type to search, or tick “In messages” to search everything that was said.
[Show my chats](command:orbit.showChats)

media.altText: The Chats list with search and filters

steps.title: See what Claude changed
steps.description:
Hover a chat and open Files and transcript: every file Claude changed, each version, Compare with now, and Restore with a preview and undo. Orbit never deletes anything.
[Show my chats](command:orbit.showChats)

media.altText: A chat's files with Compare and Restore for each version

steps.title: Reuse your best prompts
steps.description:
Every prompt you have typed, repeats collapsed and pasted text restored. Use one again in a new chat with one click.
[Show my prompts](command:orbit.showPrompts)

media.altText: The Prompts list with use again and copy

steps.title: See what you use
steps.description:
Tokens and cost by day, model and project, plus a weekly recap. Turn on plan limits to watch your 5-hour and weekly limits fill up.
[Show my usage](command:orbit.showUsage)

media.altText: Usage: cost per day, plan limits and activity

steps.title: Keep your setup healthy
steps.description:
Setup starts with a health check, then shows your MCP servers, plugins, skills, hooks, permissions and settings. Every change shows a preview first and can be undone.
[Check my setup](command:orbit.showSetup)

media.altText: Setup: health check first, then everything Claude uses

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist/
